# Key bindings

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-keybindings.ps1 from config/input.conf. Do not edit by hand. -->

Everything here comes from [`config/input.conf`](../config/input.conf), plus the
keys that the bundled scripts register for themselves. Anything not listed
keeps the default mpv binding - run `mpv --input-cmdlist` for the full set,
or press `g-b` in a running player to see the live list.

Navigation is routed through `scripts/nav_shim.lua`, which detects the active
skin. With Liquid Glass you get its centred macOS-style seek/volume/speed
overlays; with ModernZ the same keys perform the action natively and the skin
draws its own feedback. The keymap does not change when you switch skins.

## Navigation

| Key | Action | mpv command |
|---|---|---|
| `WHEEL_UP` | message `nav-scroll-up` to the `nav_shim` script | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-scroll-up` |
| `WHEEL_DOWN` | message `nav-scroll-down` to the `nav_shim` script | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-scroll-down` |
| `LEFT` | message `nav-seek -5` to the `nav_shim` script | `repeatable script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek -5` |
| `RIGHT` | message `nav-seek  5` to the `nav_shim` script | `repeatable script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek  5` |
| `Shift+LEFT` | `seek -1 exact` | `repeatable seek -1 exact` |
| `Shift+RIGHT` | `seek  1 exact` | `repeatable seek  1 exact` |
| `Ctrl+LEFT` | `seek -10 exact` | `repeatable seek -10 exact` |
| `Ctrl+RIGHT` | `seek  10 exact` | `repeatable seek  10 exact` |
| `PGUP` | `seek 60` | `seek 60` |
| `PGDWN` | `seek -60` | `seek -60` |
| `,` | `frame-back-step` | `frame-back-step` |
| `.` | `frame-step` | `frame-step` |
| `UP` | message `nav-volume  5` to the `nav_shim` script | `repeatable script-message-to nav_shim nav-volume  5` |
| `DOWN` | message `nav-volume -5` to the `nav_shim` script | `repeatable script-message-to nav_shim nav-volume -5` |
| `0` | Number keys jump to a percentage of the video (0 = start, 1 = 10%, ...). | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 0` |
| `1` | jump to 10 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 10` |
| `2` | jump to 20 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 20` |
| `3` | jump to 30 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 30` |
| `4` | jump to 40 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 40` |
| `5` | jump to 50 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 50` |
| `6` | jump to 60 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 60` |
| `7` | jump to 70 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 70` |
| `8` | jump to 80 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 80` |
| `9` | jump to 90 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 90` |
| `KP0` | jump to 0 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 0` |
| `KP1` | jump to 10 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 10` |
| `KP2` | jump to 20 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 20` |
| `KP3` | jump to 30 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 30` |
| `KP4` | jump to 40 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 40` |
| `KP5` | jump to 50 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 50` |
| `KP6` | jump to 60 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 60` |
| `KP7` | jump to 70 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 70` |
| `KP8` | jump to 80 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 80` |
| `KP9` | jump to 90 % of the duration | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-seek-percent 90` |

## Playback

| Key | Action | mpv command |
|---|---|---|
| `MBTN_RIGHT` | Right-click toggles pause (the skin renders its own pause indicator). | `cycle pause` |

## Speed

| Key | Action | mpv command |
|---|---|---|
| `{` | message `nav-speed 1` to the `nav_shim` script | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-speed 1` |
| `}` | message `nav-speed -1` to the `nav_shim` script | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-speed -1` |
| `BS` | message `nav-speed-reset` to the `nav_shim` script | `script-message-to nav_shim nav-speed-reset` |

## Audio

| Key | Action | mpv command |
|---|---|---|
| `a` | `cycle audio` | `cycle audio` |
| `Alt+a` | `cycle audio down` | `cycle audio down` |
| `A` | runs the `uosc/audio` command | `script-binding uosc/audio` |
| `[` | `add audio-delay -0.1` | `add audio-delay -0.1` |
| `]` | `add audio-delay 0.1` | `add audio-delay 0.1` |
| `\` | `set audio-delay 0` | `set audio-delay 0` |

## Subtitles

| Key | Action | mpv command |
|---|---|---|
| `v` | `cycle sub` | `cycle sub` |
| `Alt+Shift+v` | `cycle sub down` | `cycle sub down` |
| `Alt+v` | `cycle sub-visibility` | `cycle sub-visibility` |
| `V` | Subtitle menu: pick a track, or download one from OpenSubtitles. | `script-binding uosc/subtitles` |
| `D` | Download subtitles from the online providers. | `script-binding uosc/download-subtitles` |
| `Ctrl+v` | and aborts startup with "[e] Command sub-add: required argument url not set". | `script-binding uosc/load-subtitles` |
| `Alt+d` | Load an external subtitle file (same thing, through the menu browser). | `script-binding uosc/load-subtitles` |
| `z` | `add sub-delay -0.1` | `add sub-delay -0.1` |
| `Z` | `add sub-delay 0.1` | `add sub-delay 0.1` |
| `Ctrl+z` | `set sub-delay 0` | `set sub-delay 0` |
| `x` | `add sub-pos -1` | `add sub-pos -1` |
| `X` | `add sub-pos 1` | `add sub-pos 1` |
| `r` | `add sub-scale +0.1` | `add sub-scale +0.1` |
| `R` | `add sub-scale -0.1` | `add sub-scale -0.1` |
| `Ctrl+j` | `add sub-font-size 2` | `add sub-font-size 2` |
| `Ctrl+J` | `add sub-font-size -2` | `add sub-font-size -2` |

## Screenshots

| Key | Action | mpv command |
|---|---|---|
| `s` | mpv itself only writes to the console, so show a proper OSD message. | `show-text "Screenshot saved"; screenshot` |
| `S` | `show-text "Screenshot saved - video only"; screenshot video` | `show-text "Screenshot saved - video only"; screenshot video` |
| `Ctrl+s` | `show-text "Screenshot saved - video only"; screenshot video` | `show-text "Screenshot saved - video only"; screenshot video` |

## YouTube / stream quality

| Key | Action | mpv command |
|---|---|---|
| `F` | Lists the REAL formats the server offers and switches on the fly. | `script-binding quality_menu/video_formats_toggle` |
| `Alt+f` | runs the `quality_menu/audio_formats_toggle` command | `script-binding quality_menu/audio_formats_toggle` |
| `Ctrl+r` | runs the `quality_menu/reload` command | `script-binding quality_menu/reload` |

## Recent files

| Key | Action | mpv command |
|---|---|---|
| `Ctrl+Shift+r` | runs the `recentmenu/open` command | `script-binding recentmenu/open` |

## YouTube subtitle picker

| Key | Action | mpv command |
|---|---|---|
| `Alt+s` | Lists every subtitle of the current YouTube video: the creator-uploaded | `script-binding ytsubs/menu` |
| `Alt+Shift+s` | runs the `ytsubs/menu-secondary` command | `script-binding ytsubs/menu-secondary` |

## Fetching

| Key | Action | mpv command |
|---|---|---|
| `Alt+Shift+b` | Fetch the whole file into the on-disk cache, then play it from there. | `apply-profile fetch-all; loadfile "${path}" replace` |
| `Alt+Shift+n` | Back to normal streaming: a rolling buffer ahead of the picture. | `apply-profile fetch-all restore; loadfile "${path}" replace` |

## Profiles

| Key | Action | mpv command |
|---|---|---|
| `Alt+1` | apply the `fast` profile | `apply-profile fast` |
| `Alt+2` | apply the `max-quality` profile | `apply-profile max-quality` |
| `Alt+3` | apply the `cine` profile | `apply-profile cine` |
| `Alt+4` | apply the `shaders-anime` profile | `apply-profile shaders-anime` |
| `Alt+5` | apply the `shaders-off` profile | `apply-profile shaders-off` |
| `Alt+6` | apply the `subs-panel` profile | `apply-profile subs-panel` |
| `Alt+7` | apply the `subs-cinema` profile | `apply-profile subs-cinema` |
| `Alt+8` | apply the `loudnorm` profile | `apply-profile loudnorm` |
| `Alt+9` | apply the `dynaudnorm` profile | `apply-profile dynaudnorm` |
| `Alt+0` | apply the `gpu-vulkan` profile | `apply-profile gpu-vulkan` |

## Native mpv selections

| Key | Action | mpv command |
|---|---|---|
| `Shift+MBTN_RIGHT` | mpv 0.41 ships select.lua, which provides these menus natively. | `script-binding select/menu` |

## Background image

| Key | Action | mpv command |
|---|---|---|
| `Ctrl+Shift+K` | Idle photo background (scripts/bg.lua + script-opts/bg.conf). | `script-binding bg/next` |

## Reopen last media

| Key | Action | mpv command |
|---|---|---|
| `MBTN_LEFT_DBL` | from the exact position it was left at (scripts/lasthit.lua). | `script-binding lasthit/play` |

## Registered by the scripts themselves

These keys are registered at load time by the script named here, so they
are not in `input.conf`. Rebind them by editing the script option or the
`input.conf` entry noted below.

| Key | Script | Binding | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Alt+o` | `autosubs.lua` | `autosubs/fetch` |  |
| `Alt+p` | `pip.lua` | `pip/toggle` |  |
| `b` | `sponsorblock_minimal.lua` | `sponsorblock_minimal/sponsorblock` |  |
| `Ctrl+d` | `download.lua` | `download/download` |  |
| `Ctrl+Shift+d` | `download.lua` | `download/cancel-download` |  |
| `W` | `webm.lua` | `webm/display-webm-encoder` | default of the `keybind` option in `script-opts/webm.conf` |

## Script bindings used in `input.conf`

For reference, these are the `script-binding` targets the keymap calls. They
are provided by the scripts in `config/scripts/`, not by mpv itself.

| Binding | Provided by |
|---|---|
| `bg/next` | `scripts/bg.lua` |
| `lasthit/play` | unknown |
| `quality_menu/audio_formats_toggle` | `scripts/quality-menu.lua` |
| `quality_menu/reload` | `scripts/quality-menu.lua` |
| `quality_menu/video_formats_toggle` | `scripts/quality-menu.lua` |
| `recentmenu/open` | `scripts/recentmenu.lua` |
| `select/menu` | mpv's bundled `select.lua` |
| `uosc/audio` | Liquid Glass skin (`scripts/uosc`) |
| `uosc/download-subtitles` | Liquid Glass skin (`scripts/uosc`) |
| `uosc/load-subtitles` | Liquid Glass skin (`scripts/uosc`) |
| `uosc/subtitles` | Liquid Glass skin (`scripts/uosc`) |
| `ytsubs/menu` | `scripts/ytsubs.lua` |
| `ytsubs/menu-secondary` | `scripts/ytsubs.lua` |
